plugins.name: leadership-coach
plugins.description: A coaching partner for Viewrail leaders. Prepare for difficult conversations, build change narratives, practice through role play, and develop your team, all grounded in the six Leadership Performance Drivers.

plugins.name: order-splitter
plugins.description: Redistributes Viewrail order dollars across Terminal shipments end-to-end (fresh split or change-order repush), reconciled to the active quote, behind one PM confirmation gate.

plugins.name: viewrail-claude-starter
plugins.description: System-setup skills for the Viewrail Claude Starter Package. Includes personalize (first-run onboarding for new workspaces), adopt-standard (one-time alignment for existing workspaces), and audit-workspace (re-runnable health check). Designed to be installed alongside the Viewrail Claude Workspace zip.
